title: Shrine of the Báb
visualBrief: Golden near-hemispherical ribbed dome and small open finial lantern, eighteen-window round drum with pointed surrounds, octagonal middle stage with corner pinnacles, rectangular stone shrine core and covered open colonnade with pink stone shafts/leaf capitals, turquoise/pale patterned infill as broad shared-material geometry, paved apron/retaining base and short approximate terrain-seated approaches. Gardens/major terraces/neighboring buildings remain host context. No furnished/navigable sanctuary or exact sacred calligraphy.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q1462314 / way91970948 identifies the shrine; standard PMTiles record35184464059780 fixes its 32.1 by29.2m rectangular arcade plan and mapped center. Native +X east/+Z south and runtime heading0; the internal architectural angle0.503874710567rad follows the mapped rectangle. The garden/terrain direction puts the approximate front approach toward local-V/northeast/downhill. Exact doorway facing, individual shaft spacing and interior partitions remain picture-led approximations. Preserve independent surrounding buildings and garden context.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: The inspected 2019 exterior and recent ordinary arcade photo guide a broad golden ribbed hemisphere, eighteen-window round drum, octagonal middle stage, eight pinnacles, pale carved pointed arcade and pink round shafts/leaf capitals. Picture-led height is about31m above its level platform; no surveyed height is asserted. The approximate bay rhythm uses48 round shafts plus four white corner piers; this is not a certified historic column inventory. Exact inscriptions, ornate mosaics and interior sanctuary are simplified or omitted.
